component.name: HoloNight Viewer
component.summary: Browse local images with keyboard controls

description.p: HoloNight Viewer is a keyboard-first image viewer for native Wayland. Browse local folders, inspect images with zoom and temporary transforms, and explore a thumbnail grid without changing your original files.
View PNG, JPEG, BMP, WebP, TIFF and vector SVG images, play animated GIFs, inspect image information, and copy images or paths to the clipboard.

screenshot.caption: A landscape illustration in the dark Viewer theme

description.p: First source release with static PNG, JPEG, BMP and WebP viewing, folder browsing, temporary transforms and image copying.
